rules.name: Core Curriculum
rules.desc:
Students must enroll in CSRE 100 or one of the Minor Core courses (e.g., JEWISHST 77, JEWISHST 115, or JEWISHST 117, depending on annual course offerings) before they can declare the minor in Jewish Studies.
Please note that students are encouraged to begin the declaration process as soon as possible. The minor will be tagged as “pending” until CCSRE confirms enrollment in one of the gateway courses.

rules.name: Minor Core Courses
rules.notes: Consult with the Associate Director of Jewish Studies to confirm which active courses fulfill the Minor Core course requirement.

rules.name: Jewish Studies Electives
rules.desc:
Jewish Studies minors must complete the remaining units of their 30-unit minimum with elective coursework in Jewish Studies, with the exception below.
Jewish Studies minors may count up to 5 units of Department of African and African American Studies (DAAAS), Asian American Studies (ASNAMST), Chicana/o-Latina/o Studies (CHILATST), Comparative Studies in Race and Ethnicity (CSRE), or Native American Studies (NATIVEAM) courses toward their degree in Jewish Studies.
